latestVona.text: Eruption with volcanic ash cloud at 0029 UTC (0929 local). Best estimate of ash-cloud top is around 5840 FT (1825 M) above sea level or 1600 FT (500 M) above summit. May be higher than what can be observed clearly. Source of height data: ground observer. Ash cloud moving to east. Volcanic ash is observed to be gray. The intensity of volcanic ash is observed to be medium..
